```lean
open CategoryTheory in
theorem lg_target {C : Type*} [Category C] {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsIso f] [IsIso g] : IsIso (f ≫ g) := by
  constructor
  obtain ⟨f_inv, f_left, f_right⟩ := is_iso_iff_exists_inv.mp (IsIso f)
  obtain ⟨g_inv, g_left, g_right⟩ := is_iso_iff_exists_inv.mp (IsIso g)
  refine' ⟨g_inv ≫ f_inv, _, _⟩
  · rw [assoc, assoc]
    exact (g_right ≫ f_right).trans f_left
  · rw [assoc, assoc]
    exact (g_left ≫ f_left).trans f_right
```
